name: Human Relations Commission Liaison Committee Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Human Relations Commission Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON / TELEPHONIC / VIDEO CONFERENCE

  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Wednesday, May 17, 2023
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  May 17, 2023 / 4:02 PM

IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Lili Bosse, City Manager
  Nancy Hunt-Coffey, Community Services Director Stephanie Harris,
  Assistant Director of Community Services Patty Acuna, Human Services
  Administrator Christopher Paulson, Human Services Outreach Manager
  Enisha Clark, Human Relations Commission Chair Noelle Freeman,
  Human Relations Commissioner Pam Kraushaar, Charitable Solicitations
  Commissioner Steven Smith, Management Assistant Linda Kyriazi

1)  Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the Committee
  on any item listed on the agenda.
  None.

2)  Community Assistance Grant Funding: Application recommendations for Fiscal Year
  2023 / 2024
  The Commissioners reviewed all 30 applications with City Council Liaisons Vice Mayor
  Lester Friedman and Councilmember Lili Bosse and informed them of the
  recommendations of both the Human Relations and Charitable Solicitations Commissions.
  All Joint Ad Hoc Committee funding recommendations were approved with one caveat
  noted: The Mixed eMotion Theatrix be presented in a different manner; working outside
  of the Community Assistant Grant Fund process.
  The item will move to City Council for approval.
 3)  Proposed Event: Beverly Hills Day of Wellness – Sunday, September 10, 2023 at
  Roxbury Park
  Human Relations Commission Chair Noelle Freeman, provided a vision of the proposed
  event. After a brief discussion on alternative locations, the Liaisions supported the event
  moving forward to be presented to the full City Council with additional event details.

4)  Adjournment

Date / Time:  May 17, 2023 / 4:50 PM

Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable
efforts to accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call
(310) 285-1014 (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least forty-eight (48) hours advance
notice will help to ensure availability of services. City Hall, Council Chamber is wheelchair
accessible.
